description: Ministry of Labour - Industrial Disputes between Samastha Lanka Motor Sewaka Samithiya Vs Sri Lanka Transport Board, Mr. H. K. N. S. Herath Vs Sri Lanka Transport Board
categorisation: This gazette content contains orders made under the Industrial Disputes Act, which involves legal/regulatory matters. It specifically references statutory powers, legal appointments of arbitrators, and outlines procedures for resolving industrial disputes through arbitration. The content focuses on the application of existing legislation rather than government personnel changes or organizational restructuring.
